title: RASA Provenance Record
description: Doctrine: /root/AAA/instructions/hermes-rasa-doctrine.md §12, §29, §38a. Every memory item about a human carries an origin class and may never be silently promoted. Forbidden promotions (fail closed): F->O, P->O, I->S, R->S, I->C.

class.description: O=OBSERVED direct event · S=SELF-REPORT by the subject · R=REPORTED-BY-OTHER (A claims about B) · I=INFERENCE machine-derived · F=FICTION/persona · P=POPULATION PRIOR (literature/statistic) · C=CO-CREATED explicitly shared and agreed by the relevant humans

subject.description: The human this statement is ABOUT. Never inferred from the speaker.

speaker.description: Who said it, if it is a statement. Null for pure observation.

channel.description: e.g. whatsapp | telegram-dm | telegram-group | in-person | agent-mediation | system-observation

addressee.description: Literal addressee. 'agen n arif' style plural addressees must be preserved verbatim and MUST NOT be collapsed to a single human.

audience_present.description: Who else could see it. Empty = private.

prompted.description: Doctrine §24. true = the statement is reactive to a question or probe; false = spontaneously initiated. Hypothesis-reactive answers are weaker evidence.

spontaneous.description: Derived convenience flag; must equal (!prompted) or the record is malformed.

privacy_class.description: Doctrine §22. private-to-subject content is NOT re-presentable to the infrastructure owner merely because they own the infrastructure.

disclosable_to.description: Principals who may be shown this record. Absent/empty means the subject only.

evidence_quality.description: How the figure was obtained. 'impression' caps confidence at 0.4.

qualia_status.description: Doctrine §29 L6. 'accessible' only when the subject has actually externalised it.

shared_meaning_status.description: Doctrine §29 L7 and §3. 'unilateral' = only one human's frame; 'explicit' requires a co-authored statement.

alternatives.description: Doctrine §29 L4. At least one competing explanation is REQUIRED for class=I, F or P.

causal_bridge.description: Doctrine §13. REQUIRED whenever class=P or F is applied to an individual.

terminal_state.description: Doctrine §27. UNKNOWN-* is a valid, successful deliverable.

channel_exhausted.description: Doctrine §6/§38d. true = this modality can no longer reduce uncertainty about this target; re-mining is a defect.

supersedes.description: record id of the claim this replaces

explanatory_layer.description: Cross-Layer Promotion Law: Explanatory layer of the claim. Different sciences constrain one another; they do not automatically translate.

bridge.description: Kernel Invariant: Layer_A -> Layer_B => Bridge(A, B, E, Delta, Omega).

human_review_required.description: Mandatory human review flag when claims touch sensitive private-state, motive, or sexuality.

alternatives_considered.description: At least three plausible alternative interpretations to prevent single-story collapse.

bridge_claim.description: Required when an assertion connects observations in one layer to conclusions in another layer.

bridge_evidence.description: Explicit empirical evidence justifying the causal link between source and target layers.

falsification_conditions.description: Declared conditions under which this cross-layer bridge would be disproven.

then.description: CO-CREATED requires an identified co-author; a single speaker can never set class=C.

forbidden_promotions.reason: fiction is not a record of what happened
a population statistic is not an observation of an individual
the machine's interpretation is not the human's self-report
A's claim about B is not B's self-report
shared meaning requires both humans, not a model of them
one person's report about another is not an observation of that person

cross_layer_promotion_law.principle: Different sciences constrain one another; they do not automatically translate into one another.
cross_layer_promotion_law.enforcement: fail closed — unbridged cross-layer conclusions are rejected

arifos.enforcement: fail closed — a writer that would perform a forbidden promotion must reject the write, not warn
arifos.note: Doctrine §38b and §48 (Interdisciplinary Explanatory Layers). This schema documents the contract; the gate hook is the enforcement point.
